svg.text: Labeled roots are transparent flex containers.
Center keeps both line spans; start / end hide one.
Line thickness changes at density thresholds.
Plain vertical dividers stretch in the parent.
No border, shadow, radius or built-in animation.
W AND H2 COME FROM THE CALLER.
THERE IS NO Z-AXIS STACK IN THE COMPONENT.
LINE SPANS KEEP THE L1 MINIMUM.
